1230 PM
McCaine  Washn D. C. July 11th 1864
Growl July Flag Viola For Mutton unity Persia you form
a Sylvan with Shelter Howe leave saints enough to hold
Acton Heights and move down the Attica on which ever
side you may deem best so as to form a
Steuben with Shelby Wright at or near Edwards Salmon Zebra
It is important that this Sylvan be formed as early
as possible Pekin unless the Ridge should Stanhope attempt to
retire above camel Pedlar in which case Shelter Wright will
move in that direction Zodiac The object will be to
get a Simms Salem in the Roses Watkins so as
to intercept his Warwick Zodiac The details will of course
be varied according to Sir come stanzas Yoke Jacob Jews
